{"code": "import numpy as np

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Now check missing and invalid values again
missing_revenue = df[df['status'] == 'completed']['revenue'].isna().sum()
invalid_revenue = np.isinf(df[df['status'] == 'completed']['revenue']).sum()

print(f'Missing revenue values in completed orders after coercion: {missing_revenue}')
print(f'Invalid (Inf) revenue values in completed orders after coercion: {invalid_revenue}')

# Check if any non-zero revenue values are below 0.01 (possible rounding issue)
low_revenue = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] > 0) & (df['revenue'] < 0.01)]
print(f'Number of completed orders with non-zero revenue less than $0.01: {len(low_revenue)}')"}
